title: Cloud Service Types

header.html: Describe infrastructure as a service (IaaS); Describe platform as a service (PaaS); Describe software as a service (SaaS); Identify appropriate use cases for each cloud service type (IaaS, PaaS, and SaaS)
the official AZ-900 study guide, skills measured as of July 20, 2026

html:
1The three service types

Cloud services are grouped by how much the provider manages for you.

Type You get You manage Provider manages Azure example
IaaS (infrastructure as a service) Virtual machines, storage and networks OS, middleware, runtime, apps, data Datacenter, hardware, virtualization Azure Virtual Machines
PaaS (platform as a service) A managed platform to build and run apps Your application code and data OS, runtime, servers, patches, scaling Azure App Service, Azure SQL Database
SaaS (software as a service) A finished application Your data, users and settings Everything else Microsoft 365, Dynamics 365

Memory aid: the further right (IaaS to PaaS to SaaS), the less you manage and the less control you have.

2IaaS: infrastructure as a service

IaaS is the closest to a traditional datacenter. You rent virtual machines, storage and virtual networks.

  • You choose the operating system and install software.
  • You are responsible for patching the OS, configuring security software and managing the apps.
  • High control, high responsibility.

Use cases

  • Lift and shift migration: move an existing server to the cloud with few changes.
  • Test and development environments you can create and delete quickly.
  • Hosting apps that need a specific operating system or software setup.
  • Backup, storage and disaster recovery capacity.
  • Websites and apps with unpredictable load where you want full control.
Exam tip

. "Lift and shift" and "I patch the operating system myself" always point to IaaS.

3PaaS: platform as a service

PaaS gives you a ready environment for building, testing, deploying and managing applications without managing the servers and operating system.

  • The provider patches the OS, runs the servers and often scales the platform automatically.
  • You focus on code and data.
  • Less control over the underlying system.

Use cases

  • Developing and hosting web apps and APIs without running servers.
  • Databases as a service (managed database engines).
  • Development frameworks and business analytics tools.
  • Teams that want to move fast and avoid infrastructure chores.

4SaaS: software as a service

SaaS delivers complete applications over the internet, usually through a subscription. You use the software; the provider runs it.

  • Nothing to install or patch (usually just a browser or app).
  • You manage your data, user accounts and settings.
  • Least control over the software, least work.

Use cases

  • Email and collaboration, office productivity, customer relationship tools.
  • Business apps that are the same for many organizations.
  • When you want to use software, not run it.
Exam tip

. In every service type, data, accounts and devices stay with the customer.

5Choose the right type

The question says Pick
"full control of the operating system", "lift and shift", "install my own software on a server" IaaS
"focus on code only", "no OS patching", "build and deploy web apps quickly", "managed database" PaaS
"use a ready-made app", "email", "subscription software", "no installation" SaaS
Exam tip

. The managed database is PaaS. A virtual machine you patch yourself is IaaS. Microsoft 365 is SaaS. Serverless services such as Azure Functions are usually considered a PaaS-style model where you manage only the code.

6Responsibility by type (links to Module 1)

You are responsible for IaaS PaaS SaaS
Data, devices, accounts You You You
Applications You You (your own code) Provider
Operating system You Provider Provider
Physical hosts, network, datacenter Provider Provider Provider

7Exam Q&A

7.1 Practice questions (choose the best answer)

S1Fabrikam Outdoors wants to move an existing server to Azure with almost no changes and keep full control of the operating system. Which service type fits?

  • ASaaS
  • BPaaS
  • CIaaS
  • DServerless only
Show the answer

Answer: C. IaaS gives virtual machines with full control of the operating system, which suits lift and shift.

S2A development team wants to deploy a web app without patching or managing servers. Which service type fits?

  • APaaS
  • BIaaS
  • COn-premises
  • DPrivate cloud
Show the answer

Answer: A. PaaS manages the OS and runtime, so the team focuses on code.

S3An organization wants to give staff a ready-made email and office suite with nothing to install on servers. Which service type is this?

  • AIaaS
  • BPaaS
  • CSaaS
  • DCapEx
Show the answer

Answer: C. SaaS delivers complete applications as a service.

S4Who is responsible for patching the guest operating system of an Azure virtual machine?

  • AThe customer
  • BMicrosoft
  • CThe internet provider
  • DNobody; it is automatic
Show the answer

Answer: A. In IaaS the customer manages the operating system, including patches. (Microsoft manages the physical host.)

S5Which statement about SaaS is true?

  • AThe customer installs and patches the application servers
  • BThe customer controls the physical datacenter
  • CThe customer manages only their own data, users and settings
  • DSaaS gives the most control of the three types
Show the answer

Answer: C. In SaaS the provider runs the application; the customer manages data, users and settings.

S6A company uses a managed database service where the provider handles the server, OS and patching. Which type is this?

  • AIaaS
  • BPaaS
  • CSaaS
  • DPrivate cloud
Show the answer

Answer: B. A managed database is PaaS.

7.2 Recall questions

R1What do the letters IaaS stand for?

Show the answer

Infrastructure as a service.

R2Which type gives the most control and the most responsibility?

Show the answer

IaaS.

R3Which type delivers a finished application?

Show the answer

SaaS.

R4Name an Azure PaaS example.

Show the answer

Azure App Service (or Azure SQL Database).

R5What is "lift and shift"?

Show the answer

Moving an existing workload to the cloud with few or no changes, usually to IaaS.

R6Who always owns the customer's data?

Show the answer

The customer, in every service type.

8Quick Reference Card

Topic Key fact
IaaS VMs, storage, networks; you manage OS and up; lift and shift, test and dev
PaaS managed platform; you manage code and data; web apps, managed databases
SaaS finished application; you manage data, users, settings; Microsoft 365
Control most in IaaS, least in SaaS
Always the customer's data, devices, accounts and identities
